name: Continual-MEGA-Benchmark
description:
Continual-MEGA: A Large-scale Benchmark for Generalizable Continual Anomaly Detection
	

This repository contains the dataset for Continual-MEGA, a new benchmark for continual learning in anomaly detection, introduced in the paper Continual-MEGA: A Large-scale Benchmark for Generalizable Continual Anomaly Detection.
Continual-MEGA aims to better reflect real-world deployment scenarios. It features a large and diverse dataset that significantly expands existing evaluation settings by… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Continual-Mega/Continual-MEGA-Benchmark.
reputation: Large-scale, recent benchmark intended for the continual-learning and anomaly-detection communities and increasingly cited for robust evaluation.
